Hoshimiya Shrine, meaning Star Palace Shrine, is a name of Shinto Shrines primarily associated with [[Futsunushi]]. They are thus related to {{ill|Katori Shrines|ja|香取神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Katori Shrines|qq=}}.

{{ill|Iwasaku and Nesaku|en|Iwasaku and Nesaku|qid=Q11287276|lt=Iwasaku and Nesaku|1=Iwasaku and Nesaku}} are also worshipped there was with [[Amatsu-Mikaboshi]]
'''Hoshimiya Shrine''' (星宮神社, *Hoshinomiya Jinja* or *Hoshimiya Jinja*) is the name of several {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}}s in Japan.
